summary: Environment A direct-binary proof that Phase 13 (Church Knowledge Base / cross-sermon analytics) compiled into the real Windows NSIS installer: the new get_church_knowledge_base command, the saved_sermon_findings persistence path, the theme-frequency/sermons-by-speaker JSON field names, and the decisive literal 'Theme: ' text-prefix convention are all present in the shipped exe, with zero regression against every prior phase's symbol tripwires.

installer.ggmlTwoPassFixNote: First build attempt failed as expected on the known whisper-rs-sys ggml lib-name defect; the build script applied its established fix and the retry succeeded - the same harmless, unrelated build-toolchain quirk documented and handled identically in every prior whisper-enabled Windows rebuild this project has done.

symbolRegressionCheck.method: x86_64-w64-mingw32-strings cip-desktop.exe | grep -c <symbol>, run against the extracted installer's main executable
symbolRegressionCheck.tripwiresResult: All 10 counts identical to the Phase 12 baseline - zero regression. whisper_full_with_state stable at 96 for a 7th consecutive rebuild (Phase 7.3 through Phase 13).
symbolRegressionCheck.priorPhaseNote: Every prior-phase symbol checked (Production Integration, Church/User Roles & Permissions, Local Congregant Companion View, Multi-language Whisper) remains present and unregressed.

newSymbolsNote: Direct strings inspection confirms the new Tauri command name (get_church_knowledge_base), the new table/persistence-function names (saved_sermon_findings, persist_saved_sermon_finding), the SermonKnowledgeBase JSON field names (themeFrequency, sermonsBySpeaker, recentFindings, occurrenceCount, sermonCount), and - most decisively - the literal 'Theme: ' text-prefix string that both sermon_adapter.rs's finding_for_theme and this phase's own element_label_for_summary/theme_text functions depend on, proving the exact cross-sermon theme-grouping mechanism (not a different one) compiled into this binary.
frontendTextSearchLimitation: The frontend bundle (dist/assets/index-*.js) is bundled into the Tauri resources directory, not searchable as plain strings inside cip-desktop.exe itself in the same way Rust symbols are - the new Church Knowledge Base section's own UI copy in HistoryView.tsx was not independently string-searched in this phase, consistent with every prior phase's installer-contents-verification methodology in this project. Frontend correctness for this phase rests on npm run typecheck's success, the fresh Vite build hash, and the full 287/287 frontend test pass.
architecturalSafetyNotes: 1 new Tauri command, zero new events, 1 new migration (saved_sermon_findings) - justified per docs/phase-13-audit.md's persistence-decision precedent.
The only new write path is inside accept_sermon_finding, an already-explicit, already-audited operator action - Detected/Reviewed/Rejected findings are never persisted to the new table.

Every prior-phase command (test_obs_connection, ensure_admin, operator_accounts, enable_congregant_companion, companion_snapshot, get_speech_language_capabilities, set_speech_language) remains present and unregressed, confirming this phase's additions did not disturb any prior gate or feature.
